The '''LEC 2021 Summer''' Split was organized by Riot Games and held in Berlin, Germany, from June 11 to August 29, 2021. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Best-of-One format during the regular season, followed by a Double Elimination Best-of-Five Playoff. The split featured a total prize pool of €200,000, with the top three teams qualifying for the [[World Championship/2021|2021 World Championship]].

{{#lst:LEC/2021/Summer/Playoffs|Playoffs}}


==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''June 11th - August 1st, 2021''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}

* '''[[LEC/2021/Championship_Points|Championship Points]]'''
**Teams are awarded points based on their performances in their respective Spring Playoffs and Summer Regular Season.
**Points determine playoff seeding after participants are determined by summer placement.
**If a team finishes in 7th-10th in summer they lose all of their points.
**1st to 6th place will play the Playoffs

* '''Playoffs''' - ''August 13th - August 29th, 2021''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Top 3 teams qualify for [[World Championship/2021|World Championship 2021]]
